component.name: MyLongboxDB
component.summary: Catalog and search your comic book collection

description.p: MyLongboxDB keeps track of a physical collection of comic books, magazines, and collected editions, with photos of their covers, in one file on your computer.

ul.li: Record every detail: creators, characters, story arcs, grades and slab certificates, signatures, where each book is stored, and what you paid
Search every field at once, with tolerance for typos, or combine filters on any field
Keep any combination of filters as a shelf in the sidebar, and hide the sidebar entries you do not use
See the gaps in your runs, your key issues, and possible duplicates
Follow what each book is worth over time, in dollars, gold, or bitcoin
Add front and back cover photos, including iPhone HEIC photos, cropped and straightened in the app
Import from a spreadsheet, and export everything to CSV and JPEG at any time
Save a checked backup copy at any time, with a safety copy kept before any risky change

description.p: MyLongboxDB never connects to the internet. It has no networking code, blocks itself from opening internet connections when it starts, and can change files only in its own folders and in files you choose. Nothing you record leaves your computer.

screenshot.caption: What each copy is worth over time
The whole collection as a list

description.p: Collection Stats, a This Copy section, and more issue details.

ul.li: A book's page has a This Copy section, and an issue's copies are listed standard covers first, then by printing, Direct or Newsstand, grading, and signatures
Record an issue's legacy number, a series' imprint, and a Canadian cover price; quick search finds legacy numbers and imprints
Series are labelled by start year, such as "X-Men (1963 series)", or by volume
Issues numbered "nn" come before numbered issues
The grid shows each issue's cover date
A Collection Stats page shows the collection's size, value, condition, and cover dates; the results bar shows the book count
Notes are labelled Notes About This Issue and Notes on This Copy, and editions are named Standard Cover, Direct, and Newsstand
A narrower sidebar, and an updated zip library

description.p: Series and name editing, signature details, and an About window.

ul.li: A book's page shows only the copy you opened; the issue's other copies are listed at the bottom under My Other Copies
Edit a series' name, start year, volume, publisher, and known issue count
Rename, merge, or delete characters, creators, and other names from a menu on each row of their lists
Record CBCS witnessed signatures, where on the book each signature is, and a photo of a signature inside the book
An About window shows the version and how much of the collection's size is cover photos
After saving, the book's page shows the copy you edited or added, and Back returns to your place in the list

description.p: Graded and signed shelves, page quality, and a fix.

ul.li: Graded Books and Signed Books in the sidebar, grouped with Key Issues
Record the page quality of comics and magazines on CGC's scale, from White to Brown / Brittle, and filter by it
Moving a single selected book to Trash now works

description.p: Saved shelves, and fixes from the first days of use.

ul.li: Keep any combination of filters as a shelf in the sidebar, and hide the sidebar entries you do not use
Find books by issue number in search
A book's page shows the copy you opened, and only that copy's photos and controls
Going back from a book returns to the same place in the list
Back up with Export a Copy, which now checks the copy and names it with the date and time
Photo crops start at the edges of the photo
Clearer messages when a file is picked for the wrong kind of import
